name: Chocolate Cake
description: Moist, rich chocolate layer cake with a tender crumb.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch round baking pans. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla; beat on medium speed for 2 minutes. Stir in the boiling water (batter will be thin). Divide batter between pans. Bake 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in pans, then turn out onto wire racks and cool completely.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Classic creamy Roman pasta with pancetta, egg, and Parmesan.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. In a skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy; add garlic and cook 1 minute. In a bowl, whisk eggs with Parmesan. Drain spaghetti and return to the warm pot. Quickly add pancetta and garlic, then pour in the egg-cheese mixture, tossing vigorously so the residual heat creates a silky sauce. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper. Garnish with parsley.

name: Ratatouille
description: Provençal vegetable bake with eggplant, zucchini, peppers, and tomatoes.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and garlic until softened. Add eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper; cook until just tender. Stir in tomatoes, season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a baking dish and bake 25–30 minutes, until vegetables are fully tender and flavors have melded. Garnish with fresh basil.

name: Lemon Cheesecake
description: Creamy lemon cheesecake on a crisp cookie crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 320°F (160°C). Mix cookie crumbs with melted butter; press into a 24 cm springform and prebake 10 minutes. Beat cream cheese with sugar until smooth; mix in sour cream, vanilla, lemon zest and juice. Beat in eggs one at a time just until combined (avoid incorporating too much air). Pour filling over crust and bake 45–55 minutes until the center still slightly wobbles. Turn off oven, crack door, and cool 1 hour inside. Cool completely, then chill at least 4 hours (preferably overnight).

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Marinated chicken in a spiced, creamy tomato sauce.
instructions: Combine yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, paprika, and salt. Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes (better 2–4 hours). Heat oil/ghee; sear chicken in batches and set aside. In the same pan, sauté onion until translucent, add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in cream, return chicken, and simmer gently 8–10 minutes until cooked through. Garnish with cilantro; serve with rice or naan.

name: Quinoa Veggie Bowl
description: Roasted veggie bowl with fluffy quinoa and tahini-lemon dressing.
ingredients: For the dressing: 2 tbsp tahini; 1 tbsp lemon juice; 1 tsp maple syrup; 1–2 tbsp water; salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss sweet potato and bell pepper with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika; roast 20–25 minutes. Add broccoli to the tray for the final 10 minutes. Cook quinoa in water/broth: bring to a boil, then simmer 12–15 minutes; fluff. Whisk dressing ingredients. Assemble bowls with quinoa, roasted veggies, and avocado; drizzle with dressing.

name: Caprese Garlic Bread (Side)
description: Toasted garlic baguette topped with mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Halve the baguette lengthwise. Mix butter with garlic and spread on cut sides. Top with mozzarella and tomato slices; season with salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil. Bake 10–12 minutes until cheese melts. Finish with basil and optional balsamic glaze.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Silky Arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and Parmesan.
instructions: Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a pot; sauté onion until translucent, add garlic briefly. Stir in rice and toast 1–2 minutes; deglaze with wine if using. Add hot broth gradually, stirring often, until rice is creamy and al dente (18–20 minutes). In a separate pan, sauté mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter; season. Stir mushrooms and Parmesan into the risotto; adjust seasoning. Garnish with parsley.

name: Harissa Roasted Carrots (Side)
description: Sweet-spicy roasted carrots with harissa and a yogurt-mint finish.
ingredients: Yogurt and chopped mint for serving (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix oil, harissa, honey, cumin, salt, and pepper. Toss carrots with the mixture and spread on a baking sheet. Roast 25–30 minutes until tender and lightly caramelized. Serve with yogurt and mint if desired.

name: Apple Crumble
description: Classic warm apple dessert with a crunchy oat crumble.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Toss apples with lemon juice, 2 tbsp sugar, and cinnamon; place in a baking dish. In a bowl, mix flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt; rub in butter until coarse crumbs form. Scatter crumble over apples and bake 30–35 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve warm (great with vanilla ice cream).
